## R, shiny and dataviz

During my 5 years at [Argus](https://www.linkedin.com/company/argusolutions/) I created the majority of reports, dashboards and analysis using R, shiny and Rmarkdown/Quarto. Most of these are still on use today, such as:

- daily reports (1200+ reports each day, sent via R) with embedded videos, reactable tables and download options

- weekly reports made with flexdashboard and echarts4r

- the main dashboard used by dozens of clients

Regarding quick prototyping: I can create things like this in 2 or 3 days when inspired:

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(slickR)
images = paste0("images/dash", 1:3, ".png")
slickR(images, height = "400px", width = "90%") + 
  settings(dots = TRUE, autoplay = TRUE, autoplaySpeed = 1500)
```

## Data engineering and machine learning

I was also responsible for the integration of several telemetry clients with our database, and the creation of APIs using plumber to allow clients to consume our data.

I implemented a drowsiness detector to answer the question: "What is the probability that this driver will sleep driving in the next hour?"

{{<video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2LoWyeiVur0>}}

I also implemented a facial recognition system which allows to identify the history of each driver without the need of identifications

{{<video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z3BVuftGhoU>}}

```{r, include=FALSE}
#| echo: false

library(reactablefmtr)
library(htmltools)

data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Language, ~Stack, ~Expertise, ~`Years using`,
  # R
  "R", "base", 4, 8,
  "R", "tidyverse", 5, 7,
  "R", "shiny", 5, 7,
  "R", "bslib", 4, 2,
  "R", "reactable", 4, 3,
  "R", "echarts4r", 5, 5,
  "R", "leaflet", 5, 4,
  "R", "tidymodels", 4, 4,
  "R", "ggplot2", 3, 4,

  # Julia
  "Julia", "base", 4, 3,
  "Julia", "Dataframes.jl", 4, 2,
  "Julia", "Tidier.jl", 4, 2,
  "Julia", "Oxygen.jl", 4, 2,

  # Python
  "Python", "pandas", 4, 2,
  "Python", "numpy", 3, 2,
  "Python", "scikit", 3, 1
) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Language), dplyr::desc(Expertise))

r = data |>
  reactable(
    theme = fivethirtyeight(centered = TRUE),
    compact = TRUE,
    columns = list(
      Language = colDef(
        style = group_merge_sort("Language")
      ),
      Expertise = colDef(
        minWidth = 80,
        maxWidth = 120,
        align = "center",
        cell = icon_assign(
          data,
          icon = "star",
          fill_color = "orange",
          align_icons = "center"
          # ,buckets = 5
        )
      ),
      `Years using` = colDef(
        cell = icon_assign(data, icon = "circle", )
        # cell = data_bars(
        #   data,
        #   bar_height = 3,
        #   text_position = "outside-end",
        #   background = "transparent"
        #   )
      )
    )
  )

r
```
